mode.label: Certificates
mode.automatic: An attendance certificate is issued to you automatically when the session completes
mode.review: An attendance certificate after the organisers review it

mine.title: My certificates
mine.intro: Every certificate issued in your name, with its serial and verification code.
mine.empty: No certificates yet. An attendance certificate is issued after a session you checked into completes.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.notFound: We found no certificate with this code.
verify.notFoundHint: Check the code exactly as printed on the certificate. The verification code is not the serial.
verify.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.

achievements.heading: Achievement certificates awaiting release
achievements.intro: Leaderboard certificates are prepared from a frozen snapshot and do not reach their recipients until you release them. A later leaderboard change cannot alter who won a closed period.

session.title: Session certificates
session.designIntro: Choose the template and its colours before the session completes: on completion every certificate is issued with them and keeps them, because a certificate records what was printed.
session.notChosen: No design chosen yet, so certificates are issued with the default template, light.
session.locked: Certificates of this kind have been issued, so their design is fixed.
session.invalid: That template does not fit this kind of certificate.
session.previewCaption: Previewed with this session's data. The serial and the verification code are issued with each certificate.
session.applyHeldTitle: {count, plural, zero {No held certificates} one {Apply the design to one held certificate?} two {Apply the design to two held certificates?} few {Apply the design to {value} held certificates?} many {Apply the design to {value} held certificates?} other {Apply the design to {value} held certificates?}}
session.applyHeldBody: Nobody has seen them yet. Their files are prepared again with the saved design, and their serials stay as they are.
session.applyHeldDone: {count, plural, zero {No certificate changed} one {One certificate redesigned} two {Two certificates redesigned} few {{value} certificates redesigned} many {{value} certificates redesigned} other {{value} certificates redesigned}}
session.whoIntro: An attendance certificate goes to everyone checked in, and a presenter certificate to every presenter who accepted — and nothing else. The list is taken when the session completes.
session.modeLink: Change the mode on the session's schedule
session.eligibleEmptyDescription: Nobody is checked in and no presenter has accepted. Names appear here when they do.
session.revokedReplaceable: Revoked because the check-in was removed — a replacement is issued once they are checked in again.
session.revokedFinal: Revoked for good — no replacement will be issued.
session.heldEmptyDescription: In review mode certificates are prepared when the session completes and wait here until you release them.
session.issuedEmptyDescription: Every certificate that reached its holder appears here.
session.revokedEmptyDescription: A revoked certificate stays here with its reason, and reads «revoked» on the verification page.
session.selected: {count, plural, zero {None selected} one {One certificate selected} two {Two certificates selected} few {{value} certificates selected} many {{value} certificates selected} other {{value} certificates selected}}
session.releaseTitle: {count, plural, zero {Nothing to release} one {Release one certificate?} two {Release two certificates?} few {Release {value} certificates?} many {Release {value} certificates?} other {Release {value} certificates?}}
session.releaseBody: Each certificate is emailed to its holder and appears in their certificates, and the release is audited. A release cannot be undone; a certificate can, by revoking it.
session.revokeBody: It reads «revoked» on the verification page, which never shows the reason. The file stays, and the serial stays used.
session.moderatorNote: You can see the design and who receives one. The certificates themselves, their release and their revocation are an admin's.
session.achievementsNote: Achievement certificates belong to no session, and are released on the recognition screen.
session.noTemplates: No published template for this kind. Copy one from the certificate template library.
session.preflightLongest: Measured with the longest name on the list: <bdi>{name}</bdi>.
session.preflightSample: Measured with the preview's data — nobody is on the list yet.
session.preflightWorker: Each certificate's file is checked again in the export engine when it is prepared; a failure appears under issuance below, with a retry.
session.notAuthorized: Design, release and revocation are an admin's.
session.failed: That did not go through. Try again.

modeExplain.off: Off: no certificate is issued for this session, and attendees see none.
modeExplain.automatic: Automatic: certificates are issued and sent as soon as the session completes, without review.
modeExplain.review: Review: certificates are prepared when the session completes and held until you release them. Their holders see nothing and no message is sent before then.

session.notCompleted: The session has not completed. Certificates are issued when it does, with the design saved above.
session.serialEstimate: Next serial expected <bdi>{serial}</bdi>, for {count, plural, zero {no certificates} one {one certificate} two {two certificates} few {{value} certificates} many {{value} certificates} other {{value} certificates}}.
session.serialEstimateHint: An estimate, not a reservation: a serial is allocated at issue, and another session's certificates may come first.
session.reasonHint: Required, and recorded in the audit log. Never shown on the public verification page.
session.reasonRequired: Write the reason for revoking, at least three characters.
session.released: {count, plural, zero {No certificate released} one {One certificate released} two {Two certificates released} few {{value} certificates released} many {{value} certificates released} other {{value} certificates released}}
session.designIntroAfter: The design the certificates were issued with. Changing it leaves what was issued as it is; it applies to held certificates if you apply it to them.
session.issuedWithLocked: This kind was issued with «<bdi>{name}</bdi>» in <bdi>{scheme}</bdi> colours, and its design is fixed.
session.issuedWithHeld: This kind was prepared with «<bdi>{name}</bdi>» in <bdi>{scheme}</bdi> colours. Change the design, then apply it to the held certificates if you want.
